FN-7BPQUEE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 344
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 344 as introduced would establish the College and Higher Education Excellence and
Results (CHEER) Act and the non-reverting CHEER Fund in the State Treasury to provide
additional funding to institutions of higher education that meet identified student and
institutional performance goals and objectives. Beginning October 1, 2026, and pursuant to the
provisions of this bill, the annual cost of the CHEER program will be determined based upon
the performance outcome goals established by the Outcomes-Based Higher Education Funding
Coordinating Committee, established pursuant to this bill and the amount of funds appropriated
by the Legislature for each fiscal year.
Additionally, this bill would increase the obligations of the Alabama Commission on Higher
Education (ACHE) to administer and distribute CHEER funds, for which ACHE may not charge
a fee. This bill would also require any funds previously appropriated to ACHE for
Outcomes-Based funding to be transferred to the CHEER Fund for allocation to eligible
institutions.
Finally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the various eligible institutions
of higher education in the state to provide annual data, required pursuant to this bill, to the
Coordinating Committee.
